comparison.objective: Choose one domino to push so the red tile falls while a vase remains upright.
comparison.physical_skill: Causal-chain selection and one controlled push.
comparison.success_condition: The red domino falls after pushing only one tile, and the vase stays standing; force and pose thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Although both involve an impulse and damage avoidance, this tests selection of a cascading rigid-body outcome, not precision tool alignment, contact-loaded notch fracture, or physical recovery of fragments.
